items.name: hooks
items.title: Hooks
items.description: Shared hooks: controllable state, reduced-motion detection and the Android press ripple.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: Small shared helpers used by several components.

items.name: provider
items.title: UniversalProvider
items.description: Root provider: Tamagui config, color mode, icons, toasts, global styles.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked sections that expand to reveal their content, such as FAQs or grouped settings.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Interrupts the user to confirm an important or destructive action before it happens.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message that draws attention without interrupting the task.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps content at a fixed width-to-height ratio as the width changes, for images, video and maps.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A profile image with an automatic initials fallback.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, counts or categories.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up to each level.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups related buttons, joined into one control or spaced apart, such as a split button or a set of actions.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface that groups related content and actions.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Lets users select one or more options, or toggle a single setting before submitting.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact element for a filter, an entered value such as a recipient, or a suggested action.

items.name: circular-progress
items.title: Circular Progress
items.description: A ring that fills as a task completes, for tight spaces and dashboards. Without a value it spins.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides a section with one trigger, such as "Show 3 more" or "Advanced options".

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for focused tasks that require the user’s attention.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A list of actions or options that opens from a button.

items.name: fab
items.title: Floating Action Button
items.description: The primary action of a screen, such as Compose or New, floating above the content.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A square, icon-only button for compact toolbars and headers.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label linked to a form control.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: Centers page content with a max width and responsive side padding.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Equal-width responsive columns that work identically on web and native.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Flexbox primitives: Box, Stack, HStack, VStack, Center and Spacer.

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation Bar
items.description: Switches between three to five top-level destinations of an app, at the bottom of the screen on phones.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Rich, interactive content anchored to a trigger, such as quick settings, filters or a short form.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how much of a task is complete.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually exclusive options where exactly one can be selected.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A box that scrolls its content within a set height or width, with thin scrollbars in the theme colors.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one option from a list — a dropdown on desktop, a bottom sheet on touch devices.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin line that divides content horizontally or vertically.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen for extra actions, details or a short form.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that previews the shape of loading content.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number, or a range, by dragging a thumb along a track.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: A brief message at the bottom of the screen about something the app did, with an optional action like Undo.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related panels of content within the same view.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field for longer input.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief, non-blocking notifications triggered imperatively with `toast()`.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggle buttons: pick one, like text alignment, or turn on several, like bold and italic.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays on or off, such as Bold in a text toolbar.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint shown when an element is hovered or focused.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Text, Heading and Kbd components built on the type scale and semantic colors.
